Container.Name: nytimes-redeem
Container.Overview: Redeems the Scottsdale Public Library New York Times pass every day at 6:05 AM (container time zone). Uses a real headful Chrome inside a virtual display. The image is built locally with: docker build -t nytimes-redeem . in the project folder (for example /mnt/user/appdata/nytimes-redeem). Logs and failure screenshots are written to the cookies folder.
Container.Requires: Pulls the published image from GitHub Container Registry. If you prefer a local build, run docker build -t nytimes-redeem . in the project folder and set Repository to nytimes-redeem.

Config.Name: Cookies and Chrome profile
Config.Description: Saved sessions, Chrome profile, redemption history and failure screenshots.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Sets what time 6:05 AM means for the daily run.

Config.Name: Library NYT link URL
Config.Description: The library link that redirects to the NYT redeem page with the gift code.

Config.Name: Library barcode or username
Config.Description: Exactly what you type in the Barcode or Username box. No quotes.

Config.Name: Library PIN or password
Config.Description: Library PIN or password. No quotes.

Config.Name: NYT account email
Config.Description: Email of the NYT account that gets the access. No quotes.

Config.Name: NYT account password
Config.Description: Password of the NYT account. No quotes. Leave email and password empty only if the account uses Google sign-in.

Config.Name: Cookie encryption key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Encrypts the saved cookie file.
